skill.name: exa
skill.description: Search the web with the Exa.ai API from an agent workflow. Requires an EXA_API_KEY environment variable.
skill.summary: Runs Exa neural search from a Node.js helper and returns focused search results.
skill.author: Dwsy

security_audit.summary: The runtime code legitimately reads EXA_API_KEY, loads dotenv config, and uses exa-js to send searches over the network. I confirmed those environment and network capabilities, while dismissing Markdown backticks, documentation-only path references, and lockfile-only dotenv entries as false positives. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: API key access and dotenv loading
remediation.suggestion: Keep EXA_API_KEY scoped to Exa only, document minimum permissions, and avoid printing or storing the key.
Tell users that search queries are sent to Exa.ai and advise against including secrets or private data.

remediation.issue: Markdown setup commands and hidden path references
remediation.suggestion: Label installation commands as optional human setup and clarify that the hidden path is only the expected install directory.

content.value_statement: Teams need current web evidence without leaving their AI coding workflow. This skill calls Exa.ai search and returns focused results for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
actual_capabilities: Runs an Exa.ai neural search from the Node.js helper.
Reads EXA_API_KEY from the environment for authentication.
Accepts the search query from command-line arguments.
Requests five search results for each query.
Prints returned search results for the calling agent to use.
Documents setup with pnpm and exa-js.
limitations: Requires a valid Exa.ai API key before use.
Sends search queries to the external Exa.ai service.
Returns a fixed set of five results unless the script is edited.
Does not include result filtering, ranking controls, or retries.

use_cases.title: Collect Web References
use_cases.description: A researcher gathers links and snippets on a topic from Exa without leaving the agent session.

use_cases.title: Check Product Context
use_cases.description: A product or support teammate searches public sources before drafting explanations or tickets.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Web Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search the web for recent information about [topic] with Exa.

prompt_templates.prompt: Use Exa to find sources comparing [option A] and [option B]. Summarize the strongest differences.

prompt_templates.title: Find Technical Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Exa to locate official docs, examples, and recent discussions for [library or API]. Cite the most relevant sources.

prompt_templates.title: Research With Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Exa to research [topic]. Prioritize primary sources, avoid low-quality summaries, and note gaps in the available evidence.

output_examples.input: Search the web for Exa neural search API usage.
output_examples.output: A concise list of Exa-related pages, documentation links, and result summaries suitable for follow-up research.

output_examples.input: Find current information about a JavaScript library release.
output_examples.output: Relevant search results with titles, source URLs, and short context from public pages.

output_examples.input: Research competitors for a product idea.
output_examples.output: A focused result set that helps identify public product pages, articles, and comparison sources.

best_practices: Use specific queries with names, dates, and source types.
Keep EXA_API_KEY in a local secret manager or environment configuration.
Review returned sources before using them in user-facing answers.
anti_patterns: Do not include passwords, tokens, or private customer data in search queries.
Do not treat search results as verified facts without source review.
Do not run the helper without confirming the API key is intended for this workspace.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It runs Exa.ai web search from a Node.js helper and returns search results to the agent.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. It requires EXA_API_KEY in the environment before the helper can search.

faq.question: Where are queries sent?
faq.answer: Queries are sent to Exa.ai through the exa-js client.

faq.question: Can it run without network access?
faq.answer: No. The skill needs network access to call the external Exa.ai API.

faq.question: Does it execute shell commands?
faq.answer: The runtime script does not execute shell commands. The documentation includes optional human setup commands for installation.

faq.question: Is it suitable for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools when Node.js dependencies are installed.
